data.one_liner: Provides extended Text and TextField widgets with inline images, custom backgrounds, and advanced selection handling.
data.what_it_does: It adds special inline span support to render images, mentions, and custom styling inside regular text. The accompanying TextField variant offers the same features for editable content, including custom toolbars and selection handles.
use_when: You need inline images or custom styled segments inside a Text widget
You require a TextField that can display rich content like mentions or emojis with custom selection UI
avoid_when: You only need plain text without special spans
You prefer a fully custom implementation rather than a library
weaknesses: Adds extra complexity to text handling
May have performance impact with many special spans
